title: CLTR Cutover shared limitations and authority-disclosure definitions
description: Bounded free-text limitations array and the authority_disclosure struct every companion record's envelope carries (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.6, Sec.9; free-text bounds per the Phase 136 implementation plan Sec.15). Limitations are disclosures only and never alter authority or lifecycle outcome.

allOf.description: Forbids every C0/C1 control character except tab (\t) and newline (\n).
At most 8 newline characters per entry.

limitation_entry.description: A single free-text limitation string. Non-empty, at most 2000 characters, at most 8 newlines, no control characters other than tab/newline. Rejected outright at the bound (never silently truncated).

limitations_array.description: The limitations array present on every records/*.schema.json file (once authored). An empty array is permitted (no limitations to disclose); duplicate entries are not locally rejected by this shared definition (duplicate-content review is a Layer 4/authoring-review concern, not a schema-shape concern).

disclosure_text.description: Single-line printable-ASCII-only disclosure sentence (no newlines, no control characters). At most 500 characters. Rejected outright at the bound.

authority_role.description: Always present. The record's own claimed authority role.

is_authoritative.description: Always present. Load-bearing const false: no schema in this shared core may declare a record authoritative unconditionally (Sec.9). A future family schema that needs a conditionally-true value defines that conditional logic itself, on its own authority_role field, never by loosening this shared const.

disclosure_text.description: Always present. Short, fixed-purpose disclosure sentence; not free-form operator prose.

authority_disclosure.description: The authority_disclosure struct. Schema validity of this struct never establishes lifecycle authority, cutover eligibility, authorization, publication success, or recovery truth (Sec.1, Sec.40).
